items.problem: `request_permission` drops the result of the OS permission request screen when a foreground read started while the screen was open, and the cache can then stay wrong until the next return from the background. `open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/push-core.md:56` says it "caches and returns that result". Run path: the permission is `Undetermined`, content code calls `request_permission` (`_read_serial` becomes N, `serial` = N) and it waits in `adapter.request_permission` at line 179, which has no time limit. The user leaves the app and returns with the screen still open, so `AppForegroundReturnedEvent` calls `_read_permission` (`_read_serial` becomes N+1), and that read ends with `Undetermined` because the user has not answered. The user then picks Allow: the caller gets `Granted`, but `serial == _read_serial` at line 182 is false, so the cache stays `Undetermined`. `get_permission` gives `Undetermined` and `schedule_local` gives `false` without a log (`_schedule`, line 265) until the next return from the background. The serial guard is correct for an older read, but a request result is newer than any read that ended before it. No test under `client/godot/core/push_core/tests/` runs a foreground return during a pending request: `test_plugin_waits.gd:112` waits on a pending request with no return, and `test_permission.gd` uses an adapter that answers at once. This code is not in the range, so this existed before it

`request_permission` does not handle the operation ID 0 that open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:59 defines for "cannot start" and waits with no time limit (`_wait_permission(plugin, 0, -1)`). Reproduced on a temporary copy: a plugin whose `start_request_permission` returns 0 and whose `permission_state(0)` returns -1; `PushCore.request_permission` had not ended after 30 frames and 33 polls, and only `release` ended it. That document does not set `permission_state` of an ID that was not started, so the hang depends on the plugin. The same missing check is at client/godot/core/push_core/adapters/native_notification_adapter.gd:35 and client/godot/core/push_core/adapters/native_push_adapter.gd:41, where the wait ends only at the time limit and the adapter then calls `cancel_permission(0)` or `cancel_token_request(0)`. client/godot/core/auth_core/adapters/tracking_adapter.gd:33 and client/godot/core/native_ui_core/adapters/native_ui_plugin_adapter.gd:42 check `id <= 0`

`spec`/`test evidence`: no test reaches the `OgwNotification` results of `permission_state` (0, 1, 2) in open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:63, or `schedule_local`, `cancel_local`, `cancel_all_local` of `NativeNotificationAdapter` against a plugin. client/godot/core/push_core/tests/support/silent_notification_plugin.gd always returns -1, and the other tests that use this adapter have no plugin. Mutation on a temporary copy: swapping the `state == 1` and `state == 2` branches, so that a granted permission reads as `Denied`, left all 61 PushCore tests passing
